Step.StepText: #A signature just landed, so this may have been the last one outstanding. "SessionNote: Seal If Complete" decides that. It is safe to call every time: a note that is already sealed, or that is still missing something, exits without changing anything. Commit first so the script reads what was just written.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.StepText: #Seal runs on the server WITHOUT waiting. BetterForms waits for this script to return, and sealing (PDF, lock, family email, K: drive) took long enough that the Data API connection was reset (ECONNRESET) after the caregiver signed. The signature is already committed above, and Seal If Complete is safe to call repeatedly, so a scheduled sweep can retry any note that did not seal.
